summary: Git archaeology on cm-main shows most of these rows map to real fixed bugs in v1 (self-heal layer, ensure-deps/better-sqlite3 boot-install, hook routing). The v2 ADRs remove the runtime mechanisms that fixed them (self-heal, ensure-deps) rather than replacing them with an equivalent automatic check. That is a regression risk the docs do not call out: ctx doctor is a manual step, but the old bug (plugin cache mismatch after a Claude Code auto-update) was fixed by an automatic SessionStart heal. One row (#1191/#1215 cluster) is a blocker-level finding. Other rows have no matching commit history in cm-main (no issue number in commit messages, no matching code string) so the v2 doc claim of 'code path gone' cannot be checked against history and is marked unverified.

items.ref: map-I0.md row #1215; ADR-0002 (heal removed); ADR-0010 doctor-and-upgrade
items.archaeology: ARCHAEOLOGY: INTRODUCED_BY d08fe6a6/8d840973 'fix(cache): 4-layer self-heal for plugin cache mismatch (anthropics/claude-code#46915)'; later narrowed by fb55ed03 'fix(start): honor CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR in cache-heal layer (#577)' and a342dd54/2965d246 'fix(hooks): narrow Layer 1 forward-heal to hooks.json only (#727)(#728)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit subject): fix a real upstream Claude Code plugin-cache mismatch that silently broke installs after an auto-update; the narrowing commits show the heal logic itself kept causing new bugs (it had already been fixed 3 times before #1215/#1191 were filed). REGRESSION_RISK: v2 (ADR-0002, D2) deletes the heal mechanism outright; ADR-0010 replaces it with `ctx doctor`, a command the user must run manually. The upstream trigger (plugin cache mismatch on CC auto-update) is unresolved by v2 unless install also writes the correct cache path at install time, not just on next manual doctor run. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: v2 must either (a) detect+fix the cache mismatch at install time, or (b) run `ctx doctor` automatically once per update, not only on manual invocation -- otherwise this is a straight regression to the original upstream bug.
items.question: Does v2 do anything automatic at install/update time to catch the plugin-cache mismatch that #1215/#1191's self-heal used to catch, or is the fix now fully manual (`ctx doctor`)?
items.recommendation: Add an install-time check (not a runtime heal loop) that detects and fixes plugin-cache path mismatch once, at install, so the original 2026 upstream bug cannot recur silently.

items.recommendation: Confirm with a repro: start two projects, trigger ctx_* writes in both, verify journal files stay separated under the v2 single-DB design before marking closed-by-design.

items.question: Does ctx_search's offset-paging page size comply with ADR-0016's MUST (large output never enters any subagent context)? If a page can still be large, #1204 is really about page-size bounding, not tool-count.
items.recommendation: Confirm ctx_search's per-page byte cap against ADR-0016 before closing #1204 as wont-fix; if no cap exists, reopen as needs-decision against ADR-0016.

items.recommendation: Re-verdict as closed-by-design (D7) rather than wont-fix/agent-removed -- the fix is architectural, not a scope cut, so it should read as covered even if OpenClaw ships later.
